description:
Every drive has a story. Keep yours with JourneyDeck.

JourneyDeck is a private driving journal for the roads you travel, the music you hear, and the memories you want to keep. Record a journey on your iPhone, then revisit its route, distance, time, and optional soundtrack in your personal archive.

REMEMBER EVERY ROAD
Start and finish journeys from your iPhone, use companion controls on Apple Watch, or ask Siri to start or stop a journey. Recording is manual and local first, so your route can be saved without a server connection.

RELIVE THE JOURNEY
Watch your recorded route unfold in a smooth replay. Revisit turns and soundtrack moments, with playback controls that let you explore at your own pace. Browse your journeys on iPhone and iPad with layouts designed for each device.

HEAR YOUR ROADTRIP SOUNDTRACK
Connect Apple Music to build an optional soundtrack from your authorized listening history. Some song locations may be estimated. You can also tap Identify Song to recognize an individual track with ShazamKit. Microphone access is used only for that request; JourneyDeck never saves microphone audio.

TURN DRIVES INTO MEMORIES
Bring related journeys together in a Memory. Add your own photos and notes to remember a holiday, a favorite road, or an everyday drive that meant something. Earn ten collectible medallions as you reach milestones in journeys, music, and Memories.

DISCOVER YOUR DRIVING RHYTHMS
Explore Statistics, or unlock Atlas with JourneyDeck Plus for insights into your routes, driving rhythms, places, and soundtracks, calculated on your device.

CHOOSE YOUR OWN LOOK
Make JourneyDeck yours with Grand Touring, Warm Ivory, Cinematic Dark, and Rosewater themes and matching app icon choices. Premium themes and icons require JourneyDeck Plus.

YOUR ARCHIVE, KEPT PRIVATE
Your archive is stored on your device first. Optional private iCloud sync keeps supported archive content available across your devices using your Apple Account. Sign-in, music permissions, and iCloud sync are optional. Set private Home, Work, and School locations and create share cards with sensitive-place protection.

JOURNEYDECK PLUS
The free experience includes manual recording, optional soundtracks, Memories, and Statistics for the latest 45 days. An optional auto-renewable membership unlocks Atlas, complete locally stored history, and premium customization. Older local journeys are not deleted when membership expires. Restore Purchases is available on the membership screen.

Apple Watch controls recording on your paired iPhone; it does not record routes independently. JourneyDeck is not a navigation app. Set up recording before driving and do not interact with the app while operating a vehicle.

Privacy Policy: https://journeydeck.me/privacy

promotionalText: Turn every drive into a story—with private journey maps, music memories, driving insights, and collectible milestones for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
whatsNew:
Every drive has a story. JourneyDeck 2.0 gives you more ways to remember yours.

• Relive saved journeys with smooth route replay and soundtrack moments.
• Explore refreshed layouts for iPhone and iPad.
• Start and stop journeys with Siri, and control recording on your paired iPhone from Apple Watch.
• Bring journeys, photos, and notes together in personal Memories.
• Earn ten collectible medallions celebrating your milestones.
• Choose from Grand Touring, Warm Ivory, Cinematic Dark, and Rosewater, with redesigned app icons. Premium themes and icons require JourneyDeck Plus.
• Keep your archive connected with optional private iCloud sync.
• Enjoy improvements to recording recovery, synchronization, and visual polish.

Journey recording remains manual and local first. Music, sign-in, and iCloud sync are optional.
